 RECALL WATCH LIST: Several recalls issued ahead of holidays for whipped cream, fire pits, baby bottle sterilizers and beds
 Safety concerns prompt recalls of popular holiday items, including whipped cream, fire pits, and beds. 
 4 hours ago 
 Fiona King , 
 MACON, Georgia (41NBC/WMGT) —  Retailers and manufacturers have announced several major product recalls just ahead of the holiday season, affecting whipped cream sold at Costco, Sharper Image tabletop fire pits, baby bottle sterilizers and Medline beds and accessories. 
 Costco’s Kirkland Signature Whipped Cream Recalled 
 CREDIT: COSTCO
 Alamance Foods has recalled certain 15-ounce cans of Kirkland Signature whipped cream, sold at Costco stores in 12 states, including Georgia, between Oct. 11 and Oct. 31. The manufacturer said a batch may contain a small amount of cleaning chemical. Customers who purchased the affected product can return it to Costco for a full refund. 
 Baby Brezza Recalls 30,000 Bottle Sterilizers Over Burn Hazard 
 CREDIT: CPSC
 WASHINGTON — Nearly 30,000 Baby Brezza bottle sterilizers have been recalled after federal safety officials warned that they can overheat and pose a burn hazard.  The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission says the company’s Superfast Sterilizer Dryers may overheat when plugged in. While 32 incidents of overheating have been reported, no injuries have been reported.  The affected sterilizers were sold nationwide at T.J. Maxx, Marshalls, and online at Baby Brezza, Target, and Babylist, from January 2024 through October 2026.  Consumers who own one of the recalled sterilizers are urged to stop using it immediately and contact Baby Brezza for a free replacement. 
 Sharper Image Tabletop Fire Pits Pulled for Burn, Fire Hazards 
 Allstar Products Group is recalling about 265,000 Sharper Image tabletop fire pits after receiving four reports of injuries caused by fuel escaping while the units were in use. The recalled fire pits are branded with the Sharper Image name and a “77” logo on the front. Consumers are advised to stop using them immediately and to contact Allstar for a refund. 
 CREDIT: CPSC
 Medline Recalls Beds, Rails, Mattresses and Accessories After Deaths, Injuries 
 Medline Industries is recalling all of its beds, rails, mattresses, and related accessories sold since 2011 due to fire and entrapment risks. The recall follows reports of seven deaths and 35 serious injuries. Customers who own a Medline bed are urged to unplug it when not making adjustments and to avoid using extension cords. Medline is offering repairs, replacements, or refunds for certain products. For more information or to check eligibility, customers should contact their provider or Medline Recall Customer Service at 1-800-950-0128, option 7.
